title: I108: pipeline totality, pass 2: sort rules S1-S3 for the IR's signed operators (holon-sort-types/0.4) and their typed-model compilation, Foundry remappings and gitlinked submodules in the corpus protocol (holon-layout/0.1), SYM per model in a multi-model milestone, and Go nil maps as UNKNOWN under an opt-in (Q60); string/bytes-keyed mappings stay refused

thresholds.doc: No number is a gate (BUILD_PLAN §4, M6 exit). Each prediction holds or misses as stated; a miss is reported, never forced. P6-P10 are smoke measures on I51's corpus, already contaminated by I51/I103/I105; I107 does the scored run.
thresholds.instruments: spec/M6/lib/i108_run.json (the run protocol) and tests_m6/test_i108_pipeline_totality.py (every check)
thresholds.base: claude/holon-v2-bend2-c6z3cd at c2cd112c with claude/i103-frontend-reach (f67e9b80) and claude/i105-go-machines (d13ab328) merged

predictions.claim: Signed operators: on the planted fixture's Acct (int64 Bal and Limit; tests_m6/fixtures/i108), the Go machine document holds s<, s> and sext; holon-sort-types/0.3 records them as coverage debt; 0.4 records no debt for s<, s<=, s>, s>=, sext, sdiv, smod or sar; and Acct runs sorts, types, model, disch and derive all ok under 0.4, deriving at least one law, its model comparing signed words through the flipped sign bit.

SYM per model: a milestone of two Go machine documents (the fixture's Acct and Book, no opt-in) runs sorts through derive all ok (no 'SYM states one' refusal); holon.sym.typed_models lists both documents, and every L_sym_ law names one of them as its facts.

Nil maps (Q60): with machines.nil_maps "unknown", the fixture's Book carries nil_map debt for Credit only (the one action writing the map field Bal), Acct none; storage, actions and info equal the documents without the key, which carry no nil_map debt; and types refuses Book with a reason naming a nil map, so every law over it is UNKNOWN.

Layout: holon.eval.layout finds a unit's Foundry project (the nearest foundry.toml at or above it), reads its remappings from [profile.default] then remappings.txt (first (context, prefix) kept, rewritten relative to the checkout, plus rule L2's base-path remappings for the project's top-level directories) exactly as listed in the test, gives none outside a project, and records a submodule whose URL is not a GitHub repository or is excluded by the clone rule as refused (never cloned), with its path and gitlinked commit.
(b) is not built tonight: a string- or bytes-keyed mapping stays refused at types by the SP_b refusal; no opaque-key fallback exists, so no opaque key is equated or ordered to prove anything (Q61).

Extraction reach on I51's 20 entries under the I108 protocol: at least 14 entries extract at least one document (holon eval holon) or one Go machine (holon eval go-machines); I103 recorded 12 (c02 c03 c04 c06 c08 c09 c13 c14 c16 c17 c18 c19). The expected gains are nitro's c01 and c12 (their go-ethereum replace target is a submodule) and optimism's entries (remappings, submodules and the base path).
No Go machine entry of the go-machines run stops at sorts, and none on a signed head (I105 run 2: 7 of 8 did, on s> or sext).

Go machine entries completing sorts through derive: 0, and 0 laws: past sorts every entry still meets a types refusal (a string- or bytes-keyed map (SP_b), a whole-map havoc, a nil-map write under the opt-in, sdiv/smod/sar, or I105's tuple rendering gap), because one refusing document stops the entry's milestone.
c02 (compound, 7 models in one milestone) passes derive with SYM derived per model and derives at least one law.
Every remaining miss is recorded with its stage and reason, and the run records no verdict (stop_after derive).

regressions.claim: Morph's M0-M3 record (results/M0-M3, laws/M0-M3) moves only by re-stamp: every JSON file equals the base's (c2cd112c) with generator_sha256 removed; with the CI gates (M0, M1, M2, partial M3) and a field-by-field record comparison in docs/iterations/I108.md.
No Morph document under spec/M*/facts holds a head S1-S3 names, so holon-sort-types/0.4 walks each exactly as 0.3 and Morph's sort pass cannot move.
